SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name, i.risk_level, i.aum, i.is_tdf
FROM product p
INNER JOIN investment i ON p.id = i.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'INVESTMENT'
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name, i.risk_level, i.aum, i.is_tdf
FROM product p
INNER JOIN investment i ON p.id = i.id
WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.product_type = 'INVESTMENT'

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name, i.risk_level, i.aum, i.is_tdf
FROM product p
INNER JOIN investment i ON p.id = i.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'INVESTMENT' AND i.risk_level = #{riskLevel}
ORDER BY i.aum DESC, p.id

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name, i.risk_level, i.aum, i.is_tdf
FROM product p
INNER JOIN investment i ON p.id = i.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'INVESTMENT' AND i.is_tdf = 1
ORDER BY i.aum DESC, p.id
